skills.trigger: When evaluating a fetal or neonatal cystic lung lesion on ultrasound to distinguish between pulmonary sequestration and Congenital Pulmonary Airway Malformation (CPAM/CCAM).
steps: Apply color Doppler imaging to the cystic lung mass to assess for internal vascularity.
Identify if a distinct systemic feeding vessel (typically arising from the descending aorta) is visible entering the lesion.
Diagnose as pulmonary sequestration if a systemic feeding artery is confirmed; diagnose as CPAM/CCAM if the lesion is avascular or lacks a systemic arterial supply.
